blocks.text: Two questions in this chapter call for caution. The rulers who believe but do not confess Jesus fear being put out of the synagogue (vv. 42–43). This has prompted reconstructions of a growing conflict between Johannine believers and synagogue communities, but these verses alone do not establish one late, universal decree or a uniform break. Likewise, Jesus’ statement that, when lifted up, he will draw “all” (vv. 32–33) is explicitly tied to his death, but readers differ over whether “all” means every person, people broadly, or another scope. The wording does not support coercion.
